heading: Studies
lead: The Secretary shall study the following properties to determine the feasibility and suitability of including them within the park:

tree.text: Properties within the Wright-Dunbar Historic District.
Wright Company Factory, Dayton, Ohio. A report of the study of such properties shall be submitted as part of the general management plan required by section 410ww–2 of this title.
